recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for conditional update unless a later work group decision revisits conditional operation support more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-7926 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to remove conditional update support, but the approved change was to keep conditional update and add language explaining that transactions and conditional operations are complex and not expected on every server.
initial_application: The issue was applied through the shared FHIR-7928 implementation commit 51d2438efb, which added the optionality/complexity note to conditional update, conditional delete, conditional create, and transaction sections. Jira comments on FHIR-7926 point to the same resolution as FHIR-7928 and say the change was already applied.
additional_context: The current source/http.html conditional update section still includes the shared complexity note and correctly names unsupported conditional update. Related FHIR-7927 and FHIR-7928 copy/paste regressions were corrected in separate source-changing commits.
reconciliation: No source change was made for FHIR-7926. An empty audit commit was published because current source already matches the issue's final disposition.
